mapper.sql: SELECT n.notice_id, n.project_key, n.title, n.notice_type, n.source_id, n.source_name, n.tenderee, n.agent, n.region_code, n.industry, n.budget_amount, n.publish_time, n.deadline_time, n.open_time, n.contact_person, n.contact_phone, n.source_url, n.content, n.matched_keywords, n.ai_extracted, n.input_type, n.del_flag, n.create_by, n.create_time, n.update_by, n.update_time, n.remark FROM bid_notice n
mapper.select: WHERE n.project_key = #{projectKey} AND n.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY n.publish_time ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bid_notice (project_key, title, notice_type, source_id, source_name, tenderee, agent, region_code, industry, budget_amount, publish_time, deadline_time, open_time, contact_person, contact_phone, source_url, content, matched_keywords, ai_extracted, input_type, del_flag, create_by, create_time, remark) VALUES (#{projectKey}, #{title}, #{noticeType}, #{sourceId}, #{sourceName}, #{tenderee}, #{agent}, #{regionCode}, #{industry}, #{budgetAmount}, #{publishTime}, #{deadlineTime}, #{openTime}, #{contactPerson}, #{contactPhone}, #{sourceUrl}, #{content}, #{matchedKeywords}, '0', #{inputType}, '0', #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.delete: UPDATE bid_notice SET del_flag = '2' WHERE notice_id IN #{noticeId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM bid_notice WHERE del_flag = '0'
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM bid_notice WHERE del_flag = '0' AND notice_type = #{noticeType}
